Approved evidence

Globose Technology Solutions

org.globose_technology_solutions

Prepared 15 Nov 2026 · Evidence snapshot 12 Nov 2026 · Report research-2026-11-12.1 · Evidence research-2026-11-11.candidate.1

Evidence & scope

The complete retained gts.ai Home, About and privacy texts were actually read in this new metadata phase. They consistently identify Globose Technology Solutions/GTS and the first-party footer name Globose Technology Solutions Pvt Ltd, and explicitly offer quoted commercial image/video/text/speech collection, annotation and transcription with human-in-the-loop production. GTS Dash is described as a participant/work platform, not a second supplier. Retain the failed legacy domain and the documented working-domain identity bridge as history rather than silently substituting identities. Exact legal registration, ownership, the relationship of listed overseas entities/locations and named customer-specific delivery remain unverified. Advertised workforce of 4.5 million, 136 countries, years/project totals, qualification strength and certifications are provider statements, not verified active-worker or operational-quality measurements. About-page informed-consent and security descriptions plus the privacy statement’s website/service/controller terms do not establish executed client contracts, particular corpus licenses or rights for all collected images/audio/sensitive data. This scoped available-primary capability/process/identity/limits audit supports one source-qualified operating brand conditional on independent coordinator commercial/group metadata acceptance and import of the exact five already-three-role-passed own-subject facts. It creates no new scientific wording/PASS, blanket consent/security assurance or all-catalog/research-function closure.
